items.title: sync-api: the transcriptions table, POST /v1/sync and GET /v1/transcriptions
items.red_not_run: The red leg is impossible: the new test classes need types that do not exist on the base, so no test class of this slice compiles there and no red run is possible; the mutants carry the proof.

edits.anchor: if (!header.substring(0, separator).equals(BEARER_SCHEME, ignoreCase = true)) return null

expected_red: a push with a Basic scheme carrying a live session token answers 401 and stores nothing
a list with a Basic scheme carrying a live session token answers 401
entries.rule: The scheme of the Authorization header is Bearer, and a Basic header that carries a live session token is no token.

expected_red: a push and a list with a revoked session token answer 401
a push and a list with a revoked agent token answer 401 and not 403
entries.rule: A revoked session token is refused at once; this is a mutation of the existing token store, exercised through the new route tests.

expected_red: a push and a list with a session token past its idle lifetime answer 401
entries.rule: A session token is dead at its expiry instant; this is a mutation of the existing token store, exercised through the new route tests.

expected_red: a stored time that cannot be formatted answers 503 with the fixed body
entries.rule: A stored time that cannot be formatted answers 503 with the fixed body, not a 500, because the rendering is inside the try.

expected_red: a push below the stored key version of the same client is refused with 409 and the lower text
entries.rule: A lower-version refusal answers the lower-version text, and an above-account refusal answers the above-account text.
